$comment: Read by scripts/audit.mjs. Each entry excuses one advisory until its expiry date, after which the advisory gates again. Add one only with a reason the advisory cannot apply here, and remove it once no tree reports the advisory.

exceptions.reason: No fixed version exists (every version through 4.2.0, the latest, is affected). The flaw lets a shared HTTP cache serving many users hand one user's cached response, including Set-Cookie, to another. Here the package runs only inside Astro's build (astro/dist/assets/build/remote.js, caching remote images), which serves no users and holds no cookies, and the deployed site is static files.
